digest.component_or_area: config/credential ownership across reconciler engine, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm/workflow, mcp_server
propositions: Approximately 110 direct ambient config/credential reads (os.getenv, os.environ, load_config) exist below approved composition seams across multiple subsystems and must be either cut to seam or registered with exact rationale
The legacy-exception set (C1 slice) must reach empty state with no path-glob exceptions before the ownership gate passes

All S1-S6 behavioral suites must remain green after each subsystem cutover and after legacy-facade removal, with redacted fingerprints and provider-neutral outcomes unchanged except for explicitly recorded deltas
Legacy facades, migration switches, per-job ambient reloads, and migration exceptions must be removed only after their focused suites pass and before the real tree gates
The config-ownership gate must pass on the real tree with an empty legacy-exception set and zero path-glob exceptions to confirm all config/credential names have single ownership
